name: Parry Probe (research)
description: Research for Texas the Omertosa's parry: with a melee weapon in hand, press right-click just before a hit lands. Every hit on you is logged with how long after your last right-click press it came; a press within the window (0.2 s; F10 cycles 0.15 / 0.2 / 0.3 / 0.5) cancels the hit, teleports you behind the attacker and strikes it. Ctrl+F10: any weapon counts, not just melee. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
